description: This file defines the SetNode class within the Twig templating engine, representing a node for 'set' statements in Twig templates. It includes methods for constructing the node and compiling it into PHP code.

classes.name: SetNode
classes.description: Represents a 'set' statement node in Twig, capable of capturing and assigning template content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SetNode with capture options, names, and values, optimizing for large blocks of text.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the SetNode into PHP code using the provided Compiler object.
